set.approach: Park at the White Pine trailhead in Little Cottonwood Canyon. Reaching the tower is its own adventure: climb to the top of one of the Love Canal routes and make a short rappel into the gully that feeds the top of the Love Canal waterfall, then walk upstream until just below the base of the tower, and zigzag up loose scree on the right to a base area with a tree for shade where the slab begins. The route follows the cracks that split the south face; the first belay stands among trees at the foot of the tower.
set.descent_text: Descend by reversing the approach: slide down the loose slope, follow the gully a short way, and take the side trail to the top of Delicate Flower, which is rappelled.

review.notes: Area and route pages. Descent is stated on the route page as an approach reversal.

set.approach: The standard approach to the Lone Peak Cirque is from the Peak View trailhead to Jacob's Ladder; the hike is steep and long, with no water until the cirque, and the path is easy to lose. Hyperform Wall is the first wall you meet after the long slog, before the bend into the main cirque. Queen of Spades takes the narrow corner that sits between Maidenform and Agent Orange.
set.descent_text: After the second pitch, a rappel is possible from the anchor atop Jolly Green Giant; otherwise finish up Maidenform.

review.notes: Cirque and wall pages: approach; route page: location and rappel option.
